name: dysflow
description: Source-binary sync, TDD, and form UI operations on Microsoft Access / VBA projects via the dysflow MCP. Plugin entry point for Claude Code.
_dysflow_marker: DO NOT EDIT MANUALLY — this manifest is replaced on plugin update. Use setup.sh to install; Claude Code's plugin loader treats `name` as the namespace.
_dysflow_collaboration: Coexists with Gentleman-Programming/engram plugin. Namespace separation: engram owns `engram` name + `~/.engram/`; dysflow owns `dysflow` name + `<worktree>/.dysflow/`. Hooks from both fire independently per Claude Code's per-plugin hook model — no collision at the dispatch layer.
